2607.11207.title: ProgramTab: Boosting Table Reasoning of LLMs via Programmatic Paradigm
2607.11207.paper_summary: Table-based reasoning with large language models (LLMs), which requires reasoning based on natural language questions and structured tabular data, has gained widespread attention. However, a series of issues still constrain the application of this task. The previous approaches suffered from significant performance degradation when faced with large tables due to the difficulty of long text modeling and the limitation of input length for LLMs. The text-to-SQL approach is used to efficiently extract key information from tables and generate smaller sub-tables. However, tabular data, especially web tables, often lack the necessary structure and consistency, making them unsuitable for performing mathematical logic operations using SQL queries. We propose the ProgramTab framework, which guides LLMs employing in-context learning to perform tabular data preprocessing with Python code, as well as the momentous contents extraction with row and column extraction and SQL generation. The experiment results on table reasoning datasets demonstrate that the ProgramTab framework effectively deals with table-based reasoning tasks and outperforms all LLM-based baselines.
2607.11207.paper_summary_zh: 基於大型語言模型（LLMs）的表格推理，這需要基於自然語言問題和結構化表格數據進行推理，已引起廣泛關注。<lb/>然而，一系列問題仍然限制了這項任務的應用。<lb/>以往的方法在面對大型表格時，由於長文本建模的困難和LLMs的輸入長度限制，性能顯著下降。<lb/>文本到SQL的方法被用來有效地從表格中提取關鍵信息並生成較小的子表格。<lb/>然而，表格數據，特別是網頁表格，往往缺乏必要的結構和一致性，使其不適合使用SQL查詢進行數學邏輯運算。<lb/>我們提出了ProgramTab框架，該框架引導LLMs利用上下文學習進行表格數據預處理，使用Python代碼，以及重要內容的提取，包括行和列的提取及SQL生成。<lb/>在表格推理數據集上的實驗結果顯示，ProgramTab框架有效地處理表格推理任務，並超越了所有基於LLM的基準。
